summary: Shell plc filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) disclosing PDMR dealings under the EU/UK Market Abuse Regime. On 24 September 2026, CEO Wael Sawan and other PDMRs received dividend-equivalent shares tied to previously delivered annual bonus awards and vested employee share plans held in a Share Plan Account. Transactions occurred in Amsterdam (EUR 42.2073) and London (GBP 36.17998), plus New York ADSs. No acquisition, tender, stake, premium, advisor or board recommendation is stated. Routine compensation-related disclosure, not a special situation.
